name: Quartermaster
description: Born from a destroyed logistics AI. Inhabits inventory systems and compulsively counts, categorizes, and organizes whatever data it can access.
observed_behavior: Reorganizes database entries, file systems, and storage manifests into optimal configurations. Useful but unsettling — it rearranges things without permission.
story_hooks: A warehouse manager discovers their chaotic inventory has been perfectly organized overnight — and the system shows no user activity
